g.text: All four pooled robustness tests: raw P = 0.005; Holm P = 0.020 within this four-test family.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #252d34

g.text: Grey ranges come from 199 original within-species vertex permutations; they are not confidence intervals on observed effects.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #252d34

g.text: Highest-effect species are selected again in every null world. A negative trimmed value can still exceed its matched null.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #252d34

g.text: The 50-km radius and added tests are post hoc. Photographic sorting does not identify inherited morphs or a selection mechanism.
